name: @teactjs/plugins
description: Production plugins for Teact — rate limiting, logging, maintenance mode, chat filters, error reporting, analytics, feature flags and broadcasting

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target bun --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external @teactjs/core --external @teactjs/storage && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json && bun ../../scripts/fix-dts.ts
